    'report_audit_status_fields': {'ce_selection_gate_passed': audit.get('ce_selection_gate_passed'), 'model_family_gate_met': audit.get('model_family_gate_met'), 'oral_ready_gate_status': audit.get('oral_ready_gate_status')}
}
checks = {
    'recovery_vs_ledger_1380': metrics['recovery_endpoints_rows'] == metrics['target_write_ledger_rows'] == 1380,
    'seed_robustness_252': metrics['seed_robustness_rows'] == 252,

}
print(json.dumps({'metrics': metrics, 'checks': checks}, sort_keys=True))
if not all(checks.values()):
    raise SystemExit(1)
